Methodologically, the text cross-tabulates the *kāmāvacaraduka* (the dyad concerning states belonging to the sense sphere) with the *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and indeterminate states) in the systematic conditional framework characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna* [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus].
